description: This file defines an interface 'LangExceptionInterface' within the SuiteCRM namespace. The interface includes a method getLangMessage() intended for exception classes that are translatable. The file contains licensing and project-related comments, a namespace declaration, a security check, and the interface definition.

classes.name: LangExceptionInterface
classes.description: An interface to be implemented by exception classes that require translation capability, enforcing the implementation of the getLangMessage() method.

methods.name: getLangMessage
methods.description: Returns a translatable message string for exceptions implementing this interface.
